QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Glacial Pace
QuestInfo.0: You need to decipher these commands and figure out who's behind this travesty!
QuestInfo.1: Nora the Explorer believes the Black Wings are behind this trouble! Go to the Glacier Cutter Base and find out.
QuestInfo.2: You went to the Glacier Cutter Base, as Nora the Explorer suggested.

0.0: Golly, these commands are just a puzzle waiting to be solved! I'm not sure of it, but I'm willing to wager these are the same kinds of codes they use in Edelstein!
0.1: These bad guys are looking for some kind of huuuge power source, and the currents under these glaciers will make for a super strong turbine. It just boils my britches to think of them hurting all these little animals for their own profit!
0.2: Let's team up and find these no-goodnicks! Together we can do anything! Yeah!

yes.0: Okay. You can find the enemy's den at the northeast end! Good luck!\r\n#b#e(Sail to the Glacier Cutter Base.)#k

no.0: Let me know when you want to go. Gooo team!
